# vastdata_rack_bgp_config (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vastdata_rack" "vastdb_rack" {
  name = "rack-1"
}

resource "vastdata_rack_bgp_config" "vastdb_rack_bgp_config" {
  rack_id       = vastdata_rack.vastdb_rack.id
  ip_ranges     = ["10.0.0.1", "10.0.0.10"]
  ips_represent = "odd"
  self_asn      = "65001"
  subnet_bits   = 24
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rack_id` (Number) ID of the Rack

### Optional

- `ip_ranges` (Set of String)
- `ips_represent` (String) IP address representation (odd/even)
- `self_asn` (String) ASN
- `subnet_bits` (Number) Subnet bits
